<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow" />
    <title>Verifying your browser…</title>
    <!-- No-JS visitors are sent to the image captcha automatically. -->
    <noscript>
      <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=/antibot/captcha" />
    </noscript>
    <style>
      :root { color-scheme: light dark; }
      * { box-sizing: border-box; }
      body {
        margin: 0; min-height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center;
        font: 16px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif;
        background: #f7f7f8; color: #18181b;
      }
      #antibot-ref-id {
        user-select: all; font-size: .95em; background: #e5e5ea;
        padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;
      }
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
        body { background: #0b0b0d; color: #e7e7ea; }
        .card { background: #17171a !important; border-color: #2a2a30 !important; }
        #antibot-ref-id { background: #2a2a30; }
      }
      .card {
        width: min(92vw, 420px); padding: 2rem; border-radius: 14px;
        background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e5ea; text-align: center;
        box-shadow: 0 6px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
      }
      .spinner {
        width: 34px; height: 34px; margin: 0 auto 1rem;
        border: 3px solid currentColor; border-top-color: transparent;
        border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; opacity: .6;
      }
      @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
      h1 { font-size: 1.15rem; margin: 0 0 .35rem; }
      p { margin: .25rem 0; opacity: .8; font-size: .95rem; }
      a { color: inherit; }
      .email-protection { vertical-align: middle; }
      #antibot-fallback { margin-top: 1.25rem; font-size: .9rem; }
      /* The cheapest fix gets the most weight: retrying resolves most failures,
         so this reads as the primary action
